name: event-spooled-end
description: An end spooled while the core was away, as the returning core writes it (session model §15: stamped by the worker, written by the core when it returns): session.disconnect with ts the worker's stamp of the end, to the nanosecond — never the time the core came back. The orphan end phase-01 grades: orphan_timeout fired, killed / orphan; the recording ends in the killed marker with the same stamp. In a collected run every orphan end is audited this way, before the start of the core that wrote it unless that core was told of it on channel_closed by: worker, and a gap marker standing before its end marker ends no later than the end. Whether a gap marker was due — the spool's last_seq past what the recording held — is graded only by the core's own test (C8 gap-before-end): the core deletes the spool entry once it has written the end, so no collection holds it.

instances.note: orphan is an end by TSB: killed
